test_get_model_modules_is_cached: test that get_model_modules caches results and avoids re-traversing the models directory on repeated calls
test_check_models_have_kwargs_ignores_ne: test that check_models_have_kwargs skips nested helper classes and only validates top-level model classes
test_check_models_have_kwargs_still_chec: test that check_models_have_kwargs raises an exception when a top-level model forward method omits kwargs
create_RecordingNamespace: create a RecordingNamespace object that tracks dir and getattr calls for verifying cache behavior in tests
run_patch_transformers_path: run a context manager that temporarily points check_repo at a custom transformers source tree path
